## Overview

The eleventh International Symposium on Radiative Transfer, organised by the
International Centre for Heat and Mass Transfer (ICHMT), was held in Kuşadası
from 15 to 20 June 2025. The series is the reference meeting of the
radiative-transfer community: theory, measurement and application of thermal
radiation, radiative properties of surfaces and participating media, spectral
modelling and inverse methods. The Elsevier/JQSRT Poynting Award on radiative
transfer is presented at the symposium.
